name: 3D Box + Ice: Box 0 descends · 5t at (0, 5, 1)
description:
One Up command in a 6×6 room; expect exactly 5 ticks after Start.
Player: 1 cell, starting at (0, 5, 1); Box 0: 1 cell, starting at (0, 5, 2). Terrain and fixtures: Limestone, Basalt wall, Ice.

Ticks 1–3 (each tick): Player moves 1 north; Box 0 moves 1 north.
Tick 4: Player moves 1 north.
Tick 5: Box 0 moves 1 down.

Coordinates are (x, y, z); north decreases y. Every frame is checked in all four rotations. Unmentioned objects retain their authored positions and states.
